definition: An open 311 request is past promise when the date the city's own system set for it (PRJCOMPLETEDATE, 'Dept Response Due By' on the status page) has gone by. That date is the city's, and the list includes work that is legitimately queued. It is a ranking, not an accusation.

saved_search.title: Overdue requests, oldest first
saved_search.layer: Cityworks Query Engine layer 18, "Active SRs" (service requests not currently closed or cancelled)
saved_search.expression_note: Layer 18 already holds only requests whose Status is not closed or cancelled, so the saved search needs only the date tests.
saved_search.group_by: SubmitToName (the routing the public file publishes as SUBMITTO)
saved_search.fields_note: Field names as listed in the layer metadata. Our extract read only RequestId, ProblemCode, Status, DateTimeInit, PrjCompleteDate, DateTimeClosed, Cancelled, Completed and WONeeded; SubmitToName and the coordinates came from the public file.
saved_search.public_sql: SELECT submit_to, count(*) FROM requests WHERE ts_init >= '2025-01-01' AND status_group = 'open' AND ts_promised < '2026-10-13 23:59:59' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
